en.title: dr
en.summary: This is the letter L337 from the alphabet vowel-consonant groups.

sections.title: The letters dr
paragraphs: The letters dr make a consonant cluster. A consonant cluster means two or more consonants side by side with no vowel between them. You hear this sound at the start of (drum) /drʌm/, which means a musical instrument that you hit. This letter group makes one main sound in English.

sections.title: How to say dr
paragraphs: Put your tongue tip behind the ridge of your upper teeth. Stop the air for a moment. Then pull your tongue back slightly and round your lips a little. Let the air burst out with a smooth sound. Keep your vocal cords vibrating. Touch your throat to feel it shake.

sections.title: Spelling of dr
paragraphs: These two letters appear together at the beginning of many everyday words. They make the same blended sound at the start of (drop) /drɒp/. You also hear this exact sound pattern at the beginning of (dress) /drɛs/.

sections.title: Common mistakes with dr
paragraphs: Do not insert a vowel sound between the two consonants. Avoid saying a rolling sound like a trill. Do not let your tongue touch the roof of your mouth twice. Keep the flow of air smooth as you move from the first sound into the second.
